in_marathi.name: Garud
in_marathi.long_meaning: Garud हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Garuda is the king of birds and the vehicle of Lord Vishnu. He is a powerful and fearless being who is known for his strength, agility, and loyalty.

in_bengali.name: Garud
in_bengali.long_meaning: Garud একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Garuda is the king of birds and the vehicle of Lord Vishnu. He is a powerful and fearless being who is known for his strength, agility, and loyalty.
